## **Project Title 1: Key Visualization**

```{r}
#| echo: false

#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 8
#| out-width: "100%"

library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(janitor)

data <- read_sav("RPE - Combined-2019-12-19.sav") %>%
  clean_names()

# Recode major groups
data <- data %>%
  mutate(major_grp = case_when(
    major == 6 ~ "Marketing",
    major == 9 ~ "Hospitality and Restaurant",
    major %in% c(1,2,3,4,5,7) ~ "Other Business",
    major %in% c(8,10) ~ "Non-Business",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

# Create value index
data <- data %>%
  mutate(valu_index = rowMeans(select(., valu_worth_time, valu_worth_effo), na.rm = TRUE))

# Plot
data %>%
  group_by(major_grp) %>%
  summarise(avg_value = mean(valu_index, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(major_grp, avg_value), y = avg_value)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Perceived Value of Research Participation by Major",
    x = "Major Group",
    y = "Average Value Index"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## \*\*Project Title 2

### **Key Visualization: Income Distribution Heatmap**

```{r}
#| echo: false

#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 9
#| out-width: "100%"
#| 
library(tidyverse)

relig_income_long <- relig_income %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -religion,
    names_to = "income",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  filter(income != "Don't know/refused")

ggplot(relig_income_long, aes(x = income, y = religion, fill = count)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    title = "Income Distribution by Religion",
    x = "Income Bracket",
    y = "Religion"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## **Project Title 3:**

### **Key Visualization: Animated Trend (Example)**

```{r}
#| echo: false

#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 9
#| out-width: "100%"

library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
library(gapminder)

p <- ggplot(gapminder, aes(gdpPercap, lifeExp, size = pop, color = continent)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = "Year: {frame_time}") +
  theme_minimal()

p + transition_time(year)
```

## **Project Title 4:**

### **Key Visualization: Prior GPA vs Term GPA**

```{r}
#| echo: false

#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 9
#| out-width: "100%"

library(wooldridge)
library(tidyverse)

df <- as_tibble(attend)

ggplot(df, aes(x = priGPA, y = termGPA)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "blue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Prior GPA vs Term GPA",
    x = "Prior GPA",
    y = "Term GPA"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **Key Visualization: Boxplot with Distribution Insight**

```{r}
#| echo: false

#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 9
#| out-width: "100%"

df %>%
  mutate(soph_label = factor(soph, labels = c("Non-Sophomore", "Sophomore"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(ACT), y = final, fill = soph_label)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Final Scores by ACT and Sophomore Status",
    x = "ACT Score",
    y = "Final Score"
  ) +
  theme_bw()


```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **Key Visualization: Correlation Matrix**

```{r}
#| echo: false

#| fig-width: 16

library(GGally)

df %>%
  select(attend, termGPA, priGPA, ACT, final, atndrte, hwrte) %>%
```
